analysis.headline: USD/KRW rebounds to 1,337.1 snapping 5-day drop on hot US CPI and oil jitters
analysis.summary: USD/KRW rebounded to around 1,337.1 (ECB ref 1,337.13) following five consecutive sessions of declines, closing up 6.0 KRW at 1,336.7 KRW in Seoul daytime trading. Stronger-than-expected U.S. October CPI (+0.4% m/m), hawkish Fed rhetoric, higher geopolitical oil prices, and foreign stock selling revived dollar momentum. However, pre-weekend exporter dollar selling contained upside moves within a 1,332–1,340 KRW range.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW stays below 1,480 at 1,477.8 as EUR/USD slides toward 1.105
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW remained soft at around 1,477.8 (ECB ref 1,477.80), continuing to hold below the 1,480 KRW handle. Broad dollar strength after hot U.S. inflation data and persistent Eurozone growth concerns pushed EUR/USD down to 1.1052. Although USD/KRW bounced in Seoul, the euro’s pronounced weakness against the greenback kept the cross restrained in a 1,474–1,483 KRW band.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW hovers near 835.7 per 100 JPY as USD/JPY tests 160 barrier
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW traded sideways around 8.36 KRW per JPY (~835.7 KRW per 100 JPY, ECB ref 8.357). Rising U.S. Treasury yields pushed USD/JPY to 159.7, testing the psychological 160 mark. While verbal intervention warnings from Tokyo and December BOJ rate hike prospects cushioned yen downside, the parallel rebound in USD/KRW kept the cross subdued across an 833–840 KRW band.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW holds flat near 1,768.6 on BoE 4.0% rate support ahead of UK GDP
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW closed little changed around 1,768.6 (ECB ref 1,768.57) within a 1,764–1,775 KRW range. The Bank of England’s restrictive 4.0% bank rate and sticky services inflation provided underlying support, though rising U.S. yields and pre-GDP caution dragged cable toward 1.32. Combined with the rebound in USD/KRW, the cross settled in a neutral consolidation pattern.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW firms to 200.4 as PBOC fixing defense meets Seoul dollar rebound
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW edged up to around 200.4 (ECB ref 200.41) within a 199.8–200.8 KRW range, defending the critical 200.0 KRW support mark. Despite broad U.S. dollar strength after the CPI release, the PBOC limited yuan volatility through firmer daily reference fixings and liquidity injections. In Seoul, the rebound in USD/KRW to 1,337 KRW lifted the cross back above 200 KRW.

AUD.headline: AUD slides to 907.3 KRW as surge in US yields and risk aversion weigh
AUD.brief: The Australian dollar fell to 907.3 KRW as post-CPI surges in U.S. Treasury yields and global risk aversion weighed against the RBA’s restrictive policy stance.

CAD.headline: CAD rebounds to 937.8 KRW on geopolitical oil bounce and USD/KRW lift
CAD.brief: The Canadian dollar ticked up to 937.8 KRW, supported by higher crude oil prices and a rebounding USD/KRW despite ongoing BoC-Fed monetary policy divergence.

CHF.headline: CHF retreats to 1,594.9 KRW slipping below 1,600 on high US yields
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc slid to 1,594.9 KRW below the 1,600 mark as hotter U.S. inflation boosted Treasury yields and intensified selling pressure on low-yielding currencies.

CNY.headline: CNY holds 200.4 KRW supported by PBOC fixing defense and dollar bounce
CNY.brief: The Chinese yuan firmed to 200.4 KRW as the PBOC maintained a defensive fixing stance against broad dollar gains while USD/KRW rebounded in Seoul.

EUR.headline: EUR stays subdued at 1,477.8 KRW as EUR/USD retreats toward 1.105
EUR.brief: The euro remained under pressure at 1,477.8 KRW as post-CPI dollar strength and Eurozone growth concerns pushed EUR/USD down to 1.1052.

GBP.headline: GBP holds flat at 1,768.6 KRW anchored by BoE 4.0% rate ahead of GDP
GBP.brief: The British pound held steady at 1,768.6 KRW, balanced between BoE 4.0% rate support and pressure from rising U.S. yields ahead of UK growth data.

HKD.headline: HKD rises to 170.4 KRW tracking 5-day rebound in Seoul USD/KRW rate
HKD.brief: The Hong Kong dollar climbed to 170.4 KRW under its currency board peg, mirroring the first rebound in USD/KRW in five sessions in Seoul.

JPY.headline: JPY edges to 835.7 per 100 JPY as USD/JPY approaches 160 threshold
JPY.brief: The Japanese yen traded softly at 835.7 KRW per 100 JPY as USD/JPY approached 160, though verbal intervention warnings and BOJ hike bets cushioned losses.

KRW.headline: KRW weakens to 1,337.1 after 5-day rally on hot US CPI and firm oil
KRW.brief: The Korean won eased to 1,337.1 per USD, snapping a five-day rally amid strong U.S. inflation data and oil gains, though exporter sales curbed downside.

USD.headline: USD rebounds to 1,337.1 KRW snapping 5-day slide on hot US CPI print
USD.brief: The U.S. dollar rebounded to 1,337.1 KRW (Seoul close 1,336.7) after five days of losses, boosted by above-forecast October CPI and hawkish Fed cues.
